domains.name: Food sovereignty
domains.method: Combine production, procurement, storage, redistribution and nutrition-access interventions; measure edible yield, affordability, dietary diversity and exclusion separately.
domains.failure_test: Harvest rises but affordability, dietary diversity or access among priority households does not improve.

domains.name: Skills-to-livelihood
domains.method: Map competencies to real tasks and recognized qualifications; pair coached practice with employer or cooperative validation rather than badge-only completion.
domains.failure_test: Training completion rises without verified competence, placement, retention or income improvement.

domains.name: Household resilience
domains.method: Use hazard-specific baselines and layered controls for water, food, energy, shelter, sanitation, communications and continuity planning.
domains.failure_test: Preparedness score rises while critical service outage duration or household recovery time does not improve.

domains.name: Apprenticeship commons
domains.method: Use competency-based learning with authentic tasks, formative feedback, mentorship and accessible pathways to recognized qualifications.
domains.failure_test: Engagement or course completion rises without independent demonstration of target competencies.

domains.name: Repair and reuse
domains.method: Prioritize safe diagnosis, right-to-repair information, parts compatibility, tool access, triage and escalation for hazardous work.
domains.failure_test: Repair attempts rise while successful safe repairs, lifetime extension or avoided replacement cost does not.

domains.name: Service navigation
domains.method: Translate verified eligibility and procedural information into plain-language pathways with source timestamps, confidence labels and human escalation points.
domains.failure_test: Navigation interactions rise while successful service access or application accuracy does not.

domains.name: Open evidence commons
domains.method: Store claim-source-method-population-limitations-alternatives records; distinguish observation, inference, hypothesis and decision.
domains.failure_test: More citations are collected without improved reproducibility, relevance, correction speed or decision quality.

domains.name: Regenerative restoration
domains.method: Define reference ecosystems and rights holders first; monitor survival, recruitment, invasive cover, soils, hydrology and habitat condition over time.
domains.failure_test: Planting counts rise without native recruitment, condition recovery or acceptable long-term survival.

domains.name: Neighborhood abundance
domains.method: Match voluntary needs and offers with safeguarding, fair allocation, accessibility and transparent non-debt norms.
domains.failure_test: Exchange volume rises while unmet needs, exclusion or volunteer burden do not fall.

domains.name: Benevolent invention
domains.method: Move from need to prior art, mechanism, falsifiable hypothesis, lowest-risk prototype, measurement, critique, replication and revision.
domains.failure_test: Novelty, prototype count or attention rises without independent replication or verified beneficial outcomes.
